name: Plastic Surgery
overview: Scripture reveals that God created humanity intentionally and beautifully in His own image, as seen in Genesis 1:27 and Psalms 139:13-14, affirming that each person is fearfully and wonderfully made. While the Bible forbids certain bodily markings or alterations, such as cutting for the dead in Leviticus 19:28, it also warns against valuing outward beauty above a reverent heart, emphasizing that true praise belongs to those who fear the Lord rather than those who rely on physical appearance (Proverbs 31:30). Ultimately, the pursuit of external changes can reflect vanity, which Ecclesiastes 1:2 calls fleeting and empty, encouraging believers to find their worth and identity in God's perfect design rather than in altering their bodies.
